key_insight: NEXUS makes reinforcement learning more interpretable by using symbolic meta-policies to select high-level neural skills instead of low-level actions.
engineering_relevance: Separating transparent goal selection from neural execution can simplify policy inspection while preserving task performance.
method: Combine neural skills with a hierarchical symbolic meta-policy.
Use object-centric observations for high-level reasoning and LLM-assisted reward and meta-policy design.
Compare neural, symbolic, and neuro-symbolic meta-policy architectures.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports game-based evaluations showing disentangled skills, better alignment with manual-described goals, less reward hacking, and greater robustness to game simplifications than deep RL.
watch_item: Applicability beyond the evaluated games remains unclear, particularly where reliable object-centric observations or useful skill decompositions are unavailable.
paper_title: Interpretable Meta-Policies for Neural Decision Making
